name: LUNA Video Generation Execution Layer

text_to_video.note: Model/provider availability can change; verify support in the HF model/provider catalog.

image_to_video.note: Must configure a model ID that supports image-to-video with the chosen provider.

reference_handling.if_attachment_inaccessible: Return a clear error and request an accessible asset URL or upload to the configured reference vault.

fallback.behavior: If model/provider/reference access fails, surface a clear error and allow operator to select a different supported model/provider or supply an accessible reference.

constraints: Use only the current approved identity reference set in luna_reference/identity_rules.json.
Publishing remains approval-controlled and requires explicit user approval.
